algorithm_statement: features = pathway annotations + tissue (about 41 dims); flat ridge lambda=1 gives pred and posterior var; if the candidate pool S is far larger than the budget k (k=20: S above about 3,000; k=50: S above about 10,000) rank by rank(pred)+rank(var), otherwise rank by pred; take the top k
